videos.hook_text: Podcasts Just Beat Radio For The First Time
videos.notes: a filling podcast mic against a shrinking radio dial for the decade climb, a photo-finish race for the exact 40%-vs-39% crossover, then a lit crowd-grid for the 115 million weekly listeners -- ends on radio's century head start not mattering.
